title: Language Detection & Preference
description: Added language detection (english/hindi/hinglish) via LLM. Stores preferred_language on Contact model. MessageRouter auto-detects language on first message. SystemPromptService generates language-specific instructions for each detected preference.
features: detectLanguage() in LLMService classifies: english, hindi, hinglish
Language-specific prompt instructions for each preference
Conversation continuity rules added to core behavior
